author: Thereviewhunter
quote: Predicted this would be awful since RDR2 with Red Dead not allowing the player to hire prostitutes, kill certain npcs, the game wouldn’t even let you WALK within a square mile of a Indian reservation because heaven forbid you knock an NPC with a victim status over. I knew it would be bad…just not this bad.
